title: Are AI tokens the new signing bonus or just a cost of doing business? | TechCrunch
summary: The concept of AI tokens as a form of compensation for engineers, alongside salary and bonuses, has gained traction in Silicon Valley. This approach aims to increase engineers' productivity by providing them with a budget of AI tokens to run computational tools. The trend has led to competitive leaderboards tracking token consumption and is becoming a standard job perk in tech companies.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is positive as the article discusses the innovative approach of using AI tokens as a form of compensation, which is seen as a potential recruiting tool and a standard perk that could enhance productivity in the tech industry.
